title: Make Get Started button functional with App Coming Soon interaction

requirements.text: Make the "Get Started" button in the hero section fully clickable and functional: on click, display a simple "App Coming Soon" message (modal, toast, or alert) OR redirect to a placeholder page; ensure the button is not blocked by any overlaying elements (verify z-index and pointer-events are correctly set).

quotes: The button should be clickable and functional. On click: Show a simple message "App Coming Soon" OR redirect to a placeholder page. Do NOT leave the button inactive.
Ensure no element is blocking the button (z-index issue). Make sure pointer events are enabled.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the "Get Started" button triggers a visible "App Coming Soon" message or navigates to a placeholder page
The button is not blocked by any other UI elements (z-index and pointer-events are correct)
The interaction works consistently on desktop and mobile devices

requirements.text: Apply the specified button styling to the "Get Started" button: background color #D4AF37 (gold), white text, medium border radius, and a soft shadow; ensure the styling is consistent and visually premium.

quotes: Button style: Background: #D4AF37, Text: White, Border radius: Medium, Shadow: Soft shadow

acceptanceCriteria: Button has medium border radius and soft shadow
Styling matches the premium dark theme of the landing page

requirements.text: Add smooth interaction animations to the "Get Started" button: on hover, the button should slightly scale up (e.g., scale 1.05); on click, add a small press-down animation (e.g., brief scale reduction); ensure animations are smooth, subtle, and mobile-friendly.

quotes: Add hover effect and smooth click animation. Add a simple interaction: On hover → slightly scale up, On click → small press animation

acceptanceCriteria: Button scales up slightly on hover (smooth transition)
Button shows a small press animation on click
Animations work correctly on both desktop and mobile devices
Animations are subtle and do not negatively impact usability

constraints: Keep the solution simple and clean; do not add complex navigation
Ensure the button interaction is mobile-friendly
This is a temporary action until the app is live; do not over-engineer
nonGoals: Adding backend integration for the button action
